# GitHub repository settings

The organization [`.github` repository](https://github.com/Living-Proof-Labs/.github)
owns the repository inventory, desired settings policy, audit and apply tools,
and their tests. Review every desired setting and its implementation there.

Use its [repository operations guide](https://github.com/Living-Proof-Labs/.github/blob/main/docs/repository-operations.md)
for the local commands, protected preview and apply workflow, exceptions,
verification and credential requirements. This link is navigation to the owning
repository, not an executable dependency or permission to change settings.

Published collaboration-guidelines tags retain their historical settings files
for existing pinned consumers. New settings work belongs in `.github`.
